# TikTok Shop

6 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 3 standard (1 credit), 3 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/tiktokshop/product - 1-4 credits (request-shaped)

Returns detailed information about a TikTok Shop product: price and discount, rating, review count, stock availability, variants, category, seller details (rating, followers, positive-feedback percent, 24-hour response rate, and lifetime units sold), and images. Send `include=details` to add the full listing description, brand, specifications, the shipping fee and delivery estimate, and the official-shop badge, for 3 extra credits kept only when the description comes back. Identify the product by `url` or by `product_id`; `shop.tiktok.com` product links are accepted too. Region: default US. SG, MY, TH, VN and PH product lookups are served, and carry the description, specifications and shipping on the plain call. GB and ID are temporarily unavailable and answer 503 without charge. Other regions are rejected before billing. tiktokshop/search, tiktokshop/products and tiktokshop/product/reviews keep the wider 16-market set.

**Use when** you want it for a single known product URL or product id. Default region is US; SG, MY, TH, VN and PH also resolve. GB and ID are temporarily unavailable (503, no charge); other regions 400 before billing.
**Cost** price moves with `include` · cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Pricing** 1 credit for the product. include=details holds 3 more and keeps them only when it fills a description the plain call lacked, refunding them otherwise, so a hydrated call is at most 4 credits; a SEA product, which carries its description already, settles at 1. Product lookups are cached.
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (optional, string) - Full URL of the TikTok Shop product page (`www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/...` or `shop.tiktok.com/.../pdp/...`). Provide this or `product_id`. · e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/goli-ashwagandha-gummies-with-vitamin-d-ksm-66-vegan-non-gmo/1729587769570529799`
- `product_id` (optional, string) - Numeric TikTok Shop product id, as returned in `product.id` by tiktokshop/search, tiktokshop/products and tiktokshop/user/showcase. Provide this or `url`. · e.g. `1729587769570529799`
- `region` (optional, enum: US | GB | ID | MY | TH | SG | VN | PH) - ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region for the lookup. Default US. Served: US, GB, ID, SG, MY, TH, VN, PH. Other values are rejected before billing.
- `include` (optional, enum: details) - Set to `details` (one token only) to add the listing description (`product.description`), brand, specifications, and the shipping fee, free-shipping flag, delivery estimate and official-shop badge (`shop_identity`) under `product.ext.tiktokshop` when the plain call came back without them. 3 extra credits, kept only when a description comes back; a repeat within the cache window is 0. Adds about 5 to 15 seconds when a lookup runs; read `data.hydration` for the credits held and kept and the time.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `url`, `product_id`.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` | Product description. |

+20 more (types in the full schema): `product` {image_urls, reviews_count, seller, specifications, variations}; `product.ext` {seller_id, sku_id, sold_count, tiktokshop}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}; `product.ext.tiktokshop` {delivery_days_max, delivery_days_min, delivery_estimate, free_shipping, shipping_fee} (+1 more). Page-level: `data.hydration`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktokshop/product" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/goli-ashwagandha-gummies-with-vitamin-d-ksm-66-vegan-non-gmo/1729587769570529799" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktokshop/product/reviews - 1-5 credits (request-shaped)

Returns reviews for a TikTok Shop product. Each review includes rating, text, author, buyer country, verified-purchase and incentivised-review flags, the purchased SKU, and a timestamp. Pages 10 reviews at a time through the standard `cursor` contract; `data.total` carries the product's full review count. Identify the product by `url` or by `product_id`.

**Use when** you want to read what buyers actually said, since product gives only the rating and review count, and page through the whole review corpus with the cursor.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 1 credit per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free. With `max_pages`, `max_items` or `max_credits`, each page walked is billed at this price (a cached page is free), and `max_credits` caps the total.
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈10/page (observed once) · depth unknown · price per N items not proven · typical 1.6-2.4 s

**Query params**

- `url` (optional, string) - Full URL of the TikTok Shop product page. Provide this or `product_id`. · e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/cat-nail-clipper-by-potaroma-adjustable-sizes-built-in-file-safe-for-kittens-cats/1731578642912612516`
- `product_id` (optional, string) - The ID of the product (required if url is not provided)
- `region` (optional, enum: US | GB | DE | FR | IT | ID | MY | MX | PH | SG | ES | TH | VN | BR | JP | IE) - ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region for the product (e.g. `US`). Important when the product is regionally scoped.
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number to retrieve, 10 reviews per page. Prefer passing back `pagination.next_cursor`, which carries the same position and stays correct if the underlying paging mechanism changes.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` (1) · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality); `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `url`, `product_id`.
- `reports`, `label_evidence` are no-ops without `label` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `goal`, `fit_tokens` are no-ops without `fit` - sending one alone is a free 400.
- `label`: at most 5 comma-separated values.

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.title` | Review headline. |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `review.author.name` | Reviewer name. |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |

+15 more (types in the full schema): `review` {entity_id, images, verified}; `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review.author` {avatar_url, location}; `review.rating` {max, value}; `review.ext.tiktokshop` {is_incentivized_review, reviewer_id, sku_specification}. Never filled: `review.author.reviews_count`, `review.author.url`, `review.helpful_votes`, `review.language`, `review.original_language`, `review.responses`, `review.source`, `review.translated`, `review.url`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktokshop/product/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/cat-nail-clipper-by-potaroma-adjustable-sizes-built-in-file-safe-for-kittens-cats/1731578642912612516" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktokshop/products - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the products listed on one TikTok Shop storefront: title, images, canonical URL, price and original price, discount percent, sold count, review count, rating, SKU id, and the shop's own profile (name, rating, follower count, lifetime units sold, region). Sort by best-selling (`sort_by=top`) or newest (`sort_by=new_releases`); filter by `region`. Pages through the whole catalogue via `pagination.next_cursor`, and `data.total` carries the storefront's on-sale product count.

**Use when** you want it for one shop's whole catalogue by best selling or newest, paging with the cursor, where search instead finds products across all shops.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈20/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 1 credits · typical 2.0-4.5 s

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the TikTok Shop page · e.g. `https://www.tiktok.com/shop/store/goli-nutrition/7495794203056835079`
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: top | new_releases) - Sort products by best-selling (`top`) or newest (`new_releases`). Defaults to `top`.
- `region` (optional, enum: US | GB | DE | FR | IT | ID | MY | MX | PH | SG | ES | TH | VN | BR | JP | IE) - Region to get shop products from. A storefront is only reachable from its own market, so a GB shop needs `region=GB`; the default is US. Prices are decimal amounts in the major unit of `price.currency`, and each row's price belongs to the SKU in `product.ext.sku_id`. Outside the US, TikTok prices each shopper session separately, so a product's price, and the SKU it is shown for, can differ between calls; those responses carry a `session_priced` entry in `data._warnings`.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Pagination cursor. Pass back `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` | Number of written reviews. |
| `product.seller` | Name of the seller. |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `product.ext` {seller_id, sku_id, sold_count, tiktokshop}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.description`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

**Next** `tiktokshop/product` (`url` ← `data.items[].product.url`) - Get TikTok Shop product details.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktokshop/products" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.tiktok.com/shop/store/goli-nutrition/7495794203056835079" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktokshop/sales - 0-8 credits (request-shaped)

Runs one keyword through TikTok Shop search in each market you name and returns, per market: how many listings came back (`listings`, `listings_with_sales`), their lifetime units sold added up (`units_sold`), an estimate of sales in the market's own currency (`estimated_sales`, each listing's units times its current price, `currency`), and the top listings by units (`top_products`, each with id, title, url, price, units_sold and estimated_sales). These are lifetime units of the listings on the first search page at today's price, and TikTok can return a different first page on a repeat call, so compare markets within one call; the figures are not a period total or the whole market. For sales over a period, call it on a schedule and take the difference between two calls. Each market is one call to /v1/tiktokshop/search at that endpoint's own price, so every row behind the numbers is the row that endpoint returns; a market that found nothing or failed costs nothing and reports `status` `empty` or `failed` with null figures, never 0. `data.regions[].credits` and `request_id` show each market's own call.

**Use when** you want to compare how much of a product sells in each country in one call; search returns the listings themselves.
**Cost** price depends on how many items the request sends or returns · cache 900 s
**Pricing** Metered, 0-8 credits: each market is one /v1/tiktokshop/search page billed at that endpoint's own price (1 credit), exactly as a direct call is billed. A market whose page found nothing or failed costs nothing, and a page served from cache is free. data.regions[].credits shows each market's charge and credits_used the total.
**Paging** single page - A per-market summary of each market's first search page. Page a market's listings on /v1/tiktokshop/search with that market's region.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Product keyword, sent unchanged to each market's search (1-200 characters). · e.g. `lip gloss`
- `regions` (optional, string) - Comma-separated markets, up to 8: US, GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, IE, ID, MY, MX, PH, SG, TH, VN, BR, JP. Default US. Each market costs one search page (1 credit) when it returns listings. · e.g. `US,GB,MY`
- `top` (optional, integer, 1-20) - How many top listings by units to return per market, 1 to 20. Default 5.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): {query string, method string, methodology_version string, sales_status string, credits_charged number}; `regions[]` {region string, status string, http_status number, listings number, listings_with_sales number, units_sold number, estimated_sales number, currency string, credits number, request_id string}; `regions[].top_products[]` {id string, title string, url string, price number, units_sold number, estimated_sales number}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktokshop/sales" \
  --data-urlencode "query=lip gloss" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktokshop/search - 1 credit (standard)

Searches TikTok Shop across every storefront for products matching a keyword, in any supported market. Each result is the same canonical product object `tiktokshop/products` returns, id, title, canonical URL, images, price and original price, rating, review count, sold count, seller, plus the merchandising signals only search carries: the seller trust label, where the item ships from, promotion badges, the category breadcrumb, and the demo video when the listing has one.

**Use when** you want to find products across every shop by keyword and region; products returns the catalogue of one named storefront instead.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈30/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits · typical 3.7-16 s

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword or phrase to find TikTok Shop products · e.g. `phone case`
- `page` (optional, integer, min 1) - Page number to retrieve. Prefer passing back `pagination.next_cursor`, which carries the same position.
- `region` (optional, enum: US | GB | DE | FR | IT | ID | MY | MX | PH | SG | ES | TH | VN | BR | JP | IE) - Region to search shop products in. Results, prices and currency follow the market; defaults to US. `price.current` and `price.original` are always decimal amounts in the major unit of `price.currency` in every region (10.90 means 10.90 EUR). Outside the US, TikTok prices each shopper session separately, so a product's price can differ between calls and `price.original` appears only when that session was offered a promotion; those responses carry a `session_priced` entry in `data._warnings`. Search rows do not name the SKU a price belongs to (`product.ext.sku_id` is null); `tiktokshop/products` on the seller's storefront names it.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.description` | Product description. |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` | Number of written reviews. |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `product` {seller}; `product.ext` {seller_id, sold_count, tiktokshop}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.ext.sku_id`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

**Next** `tiktokshop/product/reviews` (`url` ← `data.items[].product.url`) - Buyer reviews of each product. · `tiktokshop/product` (`url` ← `data.items[].product.url`) - Full details for each product.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/tiktokshop/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=phone case" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/tiktokshop/user/showcase - 1 credit (standard)

Fetches products featured in a TikTok user's public showcase: the products a creator promotes on their profile. Each row is the same canonical product object tiktokshop/products returns: title, price and original price, rating, sold count, images, SKU id, plus the requesting creator's handle under product.ext.tiktokshop.creator_handle. A handle that TikTok does not resolve returns 404 at no charge; a creator who exists but promotes nothing returns an empty list. Each page holds up to 20 products, a size TikTok sets and no parameter changes, at 1 credit a page; follow `next_cursor` to the end of the showcase, and the final empty page is free. A creator can add up to 2,000 products, but TikTok shows visitors a rotating selection of a large showcase (a few hundred products in the showcases we measured), so a walk of a large showcase can end with fewer products than the creator's own count, and two walks can differ by a few products. The last page of such a walk says so in `data._warnings` with a `showcase_public_view` entry. Region note: the upstream currently serves showcase lookups from the US only, so a showcase whose products are visible exclusively in another regional market can return an empty list at 0 credits.

**Use when** you want to see what a creator promotes rather than what a shop sells; a handle TikTok does not resolve returns 404 at no charge.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈20/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 1 credits · typical 2.9-3.4 s

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - The handle of the user · e.g. `mrtiktokreviews`
- `region` (optional, enum: US) - Region the lookup is served from. Currently US only (an upstream limitation; other regions are rejected before billing). Support for more regions is planned upstream but has no date.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - The `next_cursor` from the previous page. A cursor from deep in a large showcase stays valid for 7 days; an expired one is a free 400, and the walk restarts from the first page.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.reviews_count` | Number of written reviews. |
| `product.ext.seller_id` | The seller's id on the retailer. |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `product.ext` {sku_id, sold_count, tiktokshop}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Also in the sample: `post` {id string, url string}; `post.content` {text string, media_urls string, thumbnail_url string, duration_seconds null}; `post.author` {username string, display_name null, avatar_url null, verified null}; `post.engagement` {views null} (+42 more). Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.description`, `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

**Next** `tiktokshop/product` (`url` ← `data.items[].product.url`) - Get TikTok Shop product details.
